message.content: {"summary": "Fixed a dbt unique test failure on fct_orders.order_id caused by duplicate payment rows from installment payments. Created stg_payments_by_order to aggregate payments per order and updated fct_orders.sql to join this new model instead of raw stg_payments. Verified the fix with `dbt build --select +fct_orders`, resulting in all 12 nodes passing.", "key_topics": ["dbt", "unique test failure", "duplicate order_id", "stg_payments_by_order", "fct_orders.sql", "payment aggregation"], "tags": ["dbt", "data-modeling", "bug-fix", "warehouse"]
